reviews.text: Clio tint has rich and beautiful colors with a lightweight and comfortable formula. It applies smoothly on the lips, stays for a long time, and gives a fresh and elegant look. The tint keeps the lips soft, moisturized, and glossy without feeling sticky, making it perfect for everyday makeup.
reviews.zh: Clio 嘅 tint 顏色豐富又靚，質地輕盈舒服。搽上嘴嘅時候好滑，持久度高，而且望落清新優雅。隻 tint 可以保持嘴唇柔軟、保濕、有光澤，但又唔會黐笠，好啱日常妝用。

reviews.text: From top to bottom: 1, amuse Seoul girl, 2, Hince raw grape, 3, tonymoly grape syrup, 4, Clio fresh apple, 5, Colorgram plum bomb, 6, Colorgram satisfied fig, 7, Laneige blueberry jelly, and 8, Romand bare grape. Personally, I am very concerned with the tastes/ smells of my lip tints so I’ll use s for smell and t for taste when it gets in your mouth. 1, s peaches, t alcohol, 2, s peaches, t peaches + chemicals, 3, s vanilla, t vanilla + peaches, 4, s apples, t apple + chemical, 5, s peaches, t peaches + chemical, 6 same as 5, 7, s blueberry, t same, 8, s artificial grape, t disgustingly strong chemicals.
reviews.zh: 從上到下：1，amuse Seoul girl，2，Hince raw grape，3，tonymoly grape syrup，4，Clio fresh apple，5，Colorgram plum bomb，6，Colorgram satisfied fig，7，Laneige blueberry jelly，仲有 8，Romand bare grape。個人嚟講，我好在意唇 tint 嘅味道同氣味，所以我會用 s 代表氣味，t 代表食到入嘴嘅味道。1，氣味係桃，味係酒精，2，氣味係桃，味係桃 + 化學味，3，氣味係雲呢嗱，味係雲呢嗱 + 桃，4，氣味係蘋果，味係蘋果 + 化學味，5，氣味係桃，味係桃 + 化學味，6 同 5 一樣，7，氣味係藍莓，味都係一樣，8，氣味係人造提子，味係頂唔順嘅濃烈化學味。

reviews.shade: [Luxury Koshort Edition] [SET] 14 Heart Pink Dia (+Mini Gloss)
reviews.text: I love these from Clio! I have this one and the 03 blushed peach. This is a great cool toned pink color. I didn’t like the mini gloss it came with. It’s very pretty, but it has a plumping ingredient that really burned my lips. I couldn’t wear the gloss. My lips are too sensitive for any plumping lip products that irritates or burns your lips to make them look fuller. The star ratings is for the tint and not the gloss.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意 Clio 呢啲！我有呢支同 03 blushed peach。呢支係好正嘅冷調粉紅色。不過我唔鍾意跟埋嚟嗰支細 gloss。望落好靚，但係入面有令到嘴唇豐滿嘅成分，會好刺痛我嘅嘴唇。我用唔到嗰支 gloss。我嘴唇太敏感，所有用刺激或者灼熱感去令嘴唇望落更加豐滿嘅唇部產品都用唔到。星級評分係畀 tint 嘅，唔係 gloss。

reviews.text: The product itself was okay, it was creamer than expected and I got a color that was lighter than my own lips so it enhanced my lips. It was more of a mlbb shade than I expected and at first I didn't really like it because it was kinda goopy (?) And I wasn't used to the formula. The gloss tho, I have to say I love the gloss, I would buy the gloss if they sold it separately!
reviews.zh: 產品本身 ok，比預期更加 creamy，揀到嘅顏色比起我本身嘅唇色淺，所以令到我嘅嘴唇望落更加靚。比起預期更加似 mlbb 色，初初我唔係好鍾意，因為有少少杰 (?) 而且我唔係好慣呢個配方。不過 gloss 方面，我就要講我真係好鍾意，如果佢哋獨立賣 gloss 嘅話我一定會買！

reviews.text: Very pretty colour even after just one coat, I like the way it feels on the lips with one coat. If you want to build colour and add more than one coat I’m not a fan of how much product sits on the lips to build it up. It is moisturizing and does not cause any irritation. I don’t find it lasts as long as I expected and does transfer.
reviews.zh: 就算只係搽一層顏色都好靚，我鍾意搽一層嘅時候嘴唇嘅感覺。如果想加重顏色搽多過一層，我就唔係好鍾意嘴唇上面要黐住咁多先至做到。佢係保濕嘅，而且唔會引起刺激。不過我覺得佢冇預期咁持久，而且會甩色。

reviews.text: Bought it because of pretty color, but it made my lips chapped and sore in a day. I'd look for a moisturizing lip product instead.
reviews.zh: 因為顏色靚所以買，但係一日之內就令我嘴唇爆拆同痛。我會去搵一支有保濕效果嘅唇部產品。

reviews.text: I got this tint in the shade daily mauve because my skin tone is neutral leaning warm, and the shade is gorgeous! It's really similar in shade and finish to the Ilia lip oil in Tahiti, which is described as a "burnt coral". This tint is glossy and smooth and applies like a lip oil, but is less hydrating and leaves a light tint on your lips. I noticed that my lips were pretty dry after use, but I do have chronically dry lips so if your lips aren't super prone to drying out, then go for it! It also smells great :)
reviews.zh: 我揀咗 daily mauve 呢個色號，因為我膚色係偏暖嘅中性色，呢個色號真係好靚！佢嘅色調同妝效真係好似 Ilia 嘅 Tahiti 唇油，官方形容佢做「焦糖珊瑚」。呢支 tint 光澤滑溜，搽起上嚟好似唇油，但保濕度就差啲，只係喺嘴唇上面留低淺淺嘅 tint。我留意到用完之後嘴唇幾乾，但係我本身就係長期乾唇，如果你嘅嘴唇唔係特別容易乾，就可以試！佢嘅味道亦都好好 :)

reviews.text:
Very glossy tint that made my lips look like glass! The formula felt light and comfortable on the lips so I give it points for that but the reason why it’s 4 stars is that you need to moisturize your lips before as it can settle into the cracks..
As for pale plum, this is such a cute purpley-mauve shade!
reviews.zh:
呢支 tint 光澤感好勁，搽完嘴唇好似玻璃咁！質地喺嘴唇上面感覺輕盈舒服，所以呢一點我畀佢加分，但係只係 4 星係因為之前要先保濕好嘴唇，否則佢會卡喺唇紋入面..
至於 pale plum，呢個係一個好得意嘅紫調 mauve 色！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
